viewer.semantics: page navigation request to decoded source image plus two animation frames; local headless browser, not actual compositor presentation or a latency SLA

limitations: Native scores revalidate retained 16 October outputs, not a new native model run
Native and OCR sources became development data after first prediction exposure
Derived image-only fixtures share original reports/layouts and are not independent scans
References are agent-authored and have no independent human adjudication
Two narrative-layout pages remain outside the scored native table scope
Occurrence scores ignore placement; complete-table scores exclude geometry but include unconfirmed unit-note differences
Exact-table and low geometry/association results must accompany literal improvements
Viewer timing is a retained local headless decode-plus-two-frames measurement, not a current cold-load rerun or SLA
